name: Indiginus The Fiddle
help: Solo fiddle, one line (pick it with Voice). In Kontakt: Legato on, velocity zones off, Harmony and Repetitions off, Exp CC 11, Key Velocity Amt about 25, VIB VEL SPLIT 50, LEG VEL SPLIT 16, Sustains Natural, Round Robins on; set Master Key to the song's key. Velocity picks the character (plain / vibrato / slide), CC11 the loudness; double stops and shuffle bowing are played as notes. Articulation keys are momentary (confirmed 2026-10-06): the driver holds a key for the ornamented note only. Vibrato is in the samples (it cannot bloom late); chop is approximated.
